scope:
Exact one-numeraire examples; no AMM, hLP, fees, rounding or unpaid interest.

Checks economic counterexamples, not full Dusk safety or on-chain feasibility.

claim_timing.assumption: Escrowed sr shares participate in senior rewards and losses.

late_settlement_changes_rewards.assumption: Income intervals already known; production receivables not modeled.

repeated_windows.assumptions: Fixed delay, no fees/crowding, immediate renewal, half-open windows.
